items.title: Fairness, Accountability, Transparency, and Safety in AI Systems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Fairness, Accountability, Transparency, and Safety in AI Systems (PDF 114, printed 110).

blocks.text: Akhlaqi AI banane ke liye chaar cheezein zaroori hain: fairness (insaf) taake discrimination na ho, accountability (jawabdehi) taake zimmedari tay ho, transparency (shaffafiyat) taake samjhaya ja sake ke system faisle kaise karta hai, aur safety (hifazat) taake users ko nuqsan na pohanche. Maslan agar AI system talaba ke admission ke liye use ho to woh jins (gender), ilaqe, zaban ya pas-e-manzar ki buniyad par kisi talib ko na-insafi se tarjeeh ya radd na kare. University ko yeh bhi batana aana chahiye ke talib kyun chuna ya radd hua, aur agar system ghalat faisla kare to zimmedar kaun hai. Isi tarah sehat mein beemari pehchanne wala AI system ehtiyat se test kiya jaye taake woh nuqsan deh ya gumraah-kun nataij na de. Yeh usool AI ko insanon ke faide ka tool rakhte hain aur anjane bure nataij se bachate hain.

blocks.caption: Chaar akhlaqi usool
rows: Gender, ilaqa, zaban ya pas-e-manzar par tarjeeh ya radd nahi
Ghalat faisle ka zimmedar kaun hai, yeh tay ho
Bataya ja sake ke talib kyun chuna ya radd hua
Diagnosis wala AI ehtiyat se test ho taake nuqsan deh nateeja na de

blocks.prompt: AI admission system aik talib ko radd kar deta hai aur university wajah nahi bata sakti. Kaun sa usool toota?
blocks.explanation: Transparency (shaffafiyat): system ko samjhana chahiye ke faisla kaise hua. Agar koi zimmedar bhi tay na ho to accountability (jawabdehi) bhi tooti.

items: Fairness, accountability, transparency aur safety AI ke chaar akhlaqi usool hain.
Yeh AI ko insan ke faide ka tool rakhte hain.
